integrity: Uniform proof is supplied; standalone finite checks corroborate only bounded dimensions. Literature comparisons are same-model; no independent mathematical audit or external certification was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Boolean rank-one nonzero idempotents only; no claims about arbitrary idempotent matrices, arbitrary semirings, or the full-matrix graph. Some older primary sources could not be inspected completely, and mathematical priority may be affected.
title: Clique and facet spectra of rank-one idempotent Boolean relations
